tagline.en: Xiaomi-Robotics-0 — an Apache-2.0 vision-language-action policy (MiBoT) that predicts robot action chunks across several benchmarks.
tagline.zh: Xiaomi-Robotics-0——Apache-2.0 许可的视觉-语言-动作策略（MiBoT），可在多个基准上预测机器人动作块。

en: Xiaomi-Robotics-0 is a vision-language-action (VLA) policy from Xiaomi Robotics, released under Apache-2.0. Given camera views and a task, it predicts chunks of robot actions for closed-loop control — it is an action policy, not a video or world generator.

The release covers six checkpoints: a pretrain base plus checkpoints tuned for LIBERO, CALVIN ABCD->D and ABC->D, and SimplerEnv on both the Google Robot and WidowX embodiments. The default variant is LIBERO; you select the others by variant id. The pretrain base has no universal embodiment or view contract, so it needs an explicit robot type, camera keys, and view labels; the SimplerEnv variants apply their released resize and center-crop before preprocessing.

In WorldFoundry you run it through the shared policy interface — choose a variant, supply the required embodiment inputs, and step the policy in a simulator or on hardware to get variant-specific action chunks.
zh: Xiaomi-Robotics-0 是小米机器人团队推出的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，采用 Apache-2.0 许可。给定相机视角与任务，它预测用于闭环控制的机器人动作块——它是动作策略，而非视频或世界生成器。

该发布包含六个 checkpoint：一个预训练基座，以及针对 LIBERO、CALVIN ABCD->D 与 ABC->D、SimplerEnv 上 Google Robot 与 WidowX 两种形态调优的 checkpoint。默认变体是 LIBERO，其余通过 variant id 选择。预训练基座没有通用的形态或视角约定，因此需要显式指定机器人类型、相机键与视角标签；SimplerEnv 变体在预处理前会先应用其发布的缩放与中心裁剪。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一的策略接口运行它——选一个变体，提供所需的形态输入，然后在仿真或真机上逐步执行策略，得到该变体对应的动作块。

whenToUse.en: A good choice when you want an openly-licensed VLA policy for standard manipulation benchmarks — LIBERO, CALVIN, or SimplerEnv — with a pretrain base you can adapt to your own embodiment.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想要一个开放许可的 VLA 策略、用于标准操作基准（LIBERO、CALVIN 或 SimplerEnv），并需要一个可迁移到自有形态的预训练基座时，它是不错的选择。

notFor.en: It outputs actions, not video or images. Checkpoints are downloaded separately, and the pretrain base won't run without explicit robot type, camera keys, and view labels.
notFor.zh: 它输出的是动作，而非视频或图像。Checkpoint 需单独下载，且预训练基座必须提供显式的机器人类型、相机键与视角标签才能运行。

en: Six checkpoints: pretrain base plus LIBERO, CALVIN (ABCD/ABC), and SimplerEnv (Google Robot, WidowX)
LIBERO is the default variant; others selected by variant id
Adaptable pretrain base with explicit embodiment and view contract

六个 checkpoint：预训练基座，加 LIBERO、CALVIN（ABCD/ABC）与 SimplerEnv（Google Robot、WidowX）
LIBERO 为默认变体，其余通过 variant id 选择
